```plato
//==
// # Core color
//
// The shared color vocabulary. Color is linear-light RGBA with components
// nominally in [0, 1]; wide-gamut and HDR values may exceed 1. Additional color
// spaces and imaging types live in the `color-spaces-*`, `images*`,
// `image-processing-*` and `texturing*` files.

// A linear-light RGBA color (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RGBA_color_model).
// The canonical color type for computation; interpolation and arithmetic are
// component-wise.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Color (linear-light, straight alpha; A is
// straight; do not lerp/construct from sRGB bytes without decoding).
type Color
    implements INumerical
{
    R: Number;
    G: Number;
    B: Number;
    A: Number;
}
```
